title.zh: Strategy insiders sold millions, then the CFO resigned
title.en: Strategy insiders sold millions, then the CFO resigned

current_state.zh: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigned on the day of the company's quarterly earnings announcement after insiders, including CEO Phong Le, sold roughly $30 million of MSTR shares in 2026, sending the stock down more than 8%.
